Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Hiring of Housekeeping staff (sanitary staff/worker) are as per minimum wages declared by Govt of Mah arashtra increase or decrease in their wages will be as per Govt Rules 2) Service Provider requires to comply with all statutory laws of Government regarding payment to worker/ labor such as PF, ESIC ,PT, Bonus, GST etc. 3) The housekeeping staff deployed by the contractor shall strictly follow the Three-Bucket System for clea ning and disinfection of all designated areas of the hospital, including wards, OPD, corridors, laboratories, t oilets and other hospital premises, as per the prescribed hospital infection prevention and control protocols . The cleaning shall be carried out using three separate buckets as follows: 1. Bucket No. 1 – Cleaning Solution: For cleaning with an approved detergent/cleaning solution to remove dust, dirt and organic matter. 2. Bucket No. 2 – Rinsing/Clean Water: For rinsing the mop and removing the residual dirt and cleaning sol ution. 3. Bucket No. 3 – Disinfectant Solution: For applying the hospital-approved disinfectant solution at the pre scribed dilution and contact time. The housekeeping staff shall ensure that: • Separate colour-coded mops and buckets are used for different designated areas, wherever prescribed by the hospital. • The cleaning solution and disinfectant are changed at prescribed intervals or whenever visibly contamin ated. • Mops and buckets are cleaned, disinfected and dried after completion of the cleaning activity. • Separate cleaning equipment is used for toilets, patient-care areas and other designated zones to preve nt cross-contamination. • Cleaning and disinfection shall be performed under the supervision of the designated hospital supervisor y staff.

• All housekeeping personnel shall be trained in the correct cleaning and disinfection procedures and shall strictly comply with the hospital’s Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) guidelines. Any violation of the prescribed cleaning and disinfection protocol shall be treated as a deficiency in service and appropriate action shall be taken as per the terms and conditions of the contract. .
